products.title: Toilet Training Starter Kit
products.body_html:
The Toilet Training Starter Kit – Everything Aussie Families Need to Ditch Pull-Ups 🛏️

From $169 (was $251). Save $82 instantly plus get $84 in FREE training pants and Bobby's book. The complete toilet training kit 75,000+ Aussie families trust to make potty training stick day and night.

Why Parents Choose This Bundle

  • Save $82 + get $84 in free gifts: the full kit costs less than buying the bedding alone, and you walk away with 2 training pants ($58) and Bobby's book ($26) on us
  • Complete potty training solution: leakproof bedding, training pants and the picture book that helps it click — all in one box
  • Day + night cover: ditch the pull-up with confidence, around the clock
  • Mattress protection guaranteed: waterproof fitted sheet stops bedwetting accidents before they soak through
  • Safe transition out of the cot: bed guard catches the half-asleep 3am roll-out
  • Reusable + eco-friendly: machine washable, OEKO-TEX tested fabrics, BPA-free, built to last through more than one kid

What's Inside

  • Leakproof Bed Guard (140 × 100cm Semi Single) – sits at the head or foot of any bed to catch the half-asleep 3am roll-out, slides under the fitted sheet so it stays put, folds flat for travel. Reusable, machine washable, OEKO-TEX tested.
  • Leakproof Fitted Sheet (your bed size) – plush feel on top, fully waterproof underneath, wipes clean with a damp cloth. The leakproof mattress protector designed for toddler beds, kids beds and Aussie family bedrooms.
  • 2 x Toilet Training Pants (FREE — $58 value) – the daytime potty training tool with a hidden leakproof inner. Soft, breathable, BPA-free, machine washable.
  • Bobby's Big Potty Adventure Book (FREE — $26 value) – the picture book that helps toilet training click for kids aged 2 to 5.

Made For Australian Families

✔ Toddlers and preschoolers (ages 2 to 5) starting toilet training

✔ Night training and transitioning out of pull-ups

✔ Bedwetting protection for kids 3+

✔ The transition from cot to a real bed

✔ Incontinence support for older kids

✔ Aussie families wanting a reusable, eco-friendly alternative to disposable pull-ups and mattress protectors

From the first day-training attempts to the last dry night, this complete toilet training kit has you covered.

Absorbency

Every component is built and tested for real Aussie potty training accidents:

  • Waterproof Fitted Sheet: Holds 1000mL+ (Single) up to 1550mL+ (Queen and King) without leaking through to the mattress
  • Bed Guard (140×100): Locks in 500mL+ before it hits the mattress
  • Training Pants: Hidden absorbent core for the daytime "uh oh" moments

Sizing & Fit

Pick your bed size to match your child's mattress, pants size to match your child's weight (Small 5-13kg, Medium 13-18kg, Large 18-25kg), and the style you both love. The bed guard is one size (140 × 100cm Semi Single) and sits at the head or foot of any bed for spot protection.

Please review the Product Size & Material dropdown below for full details.

Eco-Smart & Reusable

All components are reusable and machine washable. OEKO-TEX certified fabrics, BPA-free, designed to last through more than one child. A better choice for your wallet and the planet than disposable pull-ups and single-use mattress protectors.

Trusted by 75,000+ Aussie families

Australian-owned family business. 30-day returns. Free shipping over $60.

products.title: 10x Pack Toilet Training Pants
products.body_html:
Toilet Training Pants 👶

 

Reusable pants that help kids feel wet, learn faster, and make toilet training easier.

 

Why They Work

  • Feel-wet design: lets kids recognise accidents and learn to use the potty
  • Pull-up style: easy for toddlers to manage themselves
  • Reusable & eco-friendly: saves money and reduces waste compared to disposables
  • Comfy & safe: gentle fabrics, PFAS-free, and kind to sensitive skin


The Orginal Cotton

  • Soft cotton inner with absorbent cotton gauze layers
  • Waterproof PUL outer
  • Classic, lightweight option for everyday training
  • Holds up-to 40ml (large)


View Sizing & Absorbency In The Below 'Product Size & Material' Drop Down.

 

Made For


✔ Toilet training practice
✔ Daytime use
✔ Kids learning independence
✔ Families who want an eco-smart alternative
